core_idea: Blade of the House of Spiders Ryōshū is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist / Support — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. Scaling conditions: Final Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Bleed) (max +2); Base Power +1 per 6 (Burn + Bleed) (max +5). Support passive (**The Master's Tutelage [師事]**) keys off **deployment order** — set your main carry as #1 deployed before the fight.

**S2 — Tripleslash - Echoshear [三連 - 殘]** adds **+3 Poise Count** at **On Use** and **+2 Poise** per **On Hit** coin. - **Rend Space [空間斬]** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up. - Apply Fragile or typed Fragility on the setup turn;
